purpose: Ensure the Task 169 orchestrator consumes official-address-enriched versions of three existing batch 171 candidates before the original input file. These are duplicate parcel_ids by design, not new candidates.
geometry_policy: Official addresses constrain the runner search area but do not constitute exact parcel or building geometry. No coordinate or polygon is asserted here.

features.name: Bluewater Shopping Centre
features.official_source_evidence: The official Bluewater site identifies more than 250 shops plus dining and entertainment and publishes the centre address as Bluewater Pkwy, Dartford, Greenhithe DA9 9ST.
features.web_source_evidence: Official centre content directly supports the Retail Property classification and exact postal search area.
features.map_source_evidence: Use the published DA9 9ST address and the official centre map to bind the exact shopping-centre parcel; do not bind the whole surrounding quarry or car-park estate without parcel evidence.

features.name: Cliveden
features.official_source_evidence: The National Trust page identifies Cliveden, includes House access information, and publishes the property address as Cliveden Road, Taplow, Maidenhead, Buckinghamshire, SL1 8NS.
features.web_source_evidence: Primary owner evidence supports the historic detached-house classification and exact estate search area.
features.map_source_evidence: Use the official address and National Trust access map to isolate the principal house footprint. Visitor-car-park postcodes must not be treated as the house geometry.

features.name: Polesden Lacey
features.official_source_evidence: The National Trust page describes an Edwardian house within a 1,600-acre estate and publishes the property address as Great Bookham, near Dorking, Surrey, RH5 6BD.
features.web_source_evidence: Primary owner evidence supports the detached historic-house classification and identifies the official property address.
features.map_source_evidence: Use the official property map to bind the principal house footprint. The page separately recommends KT23 4PZ for sat-nav travel, so neither postcode alone may be used as parcel geometry.
